set.body:
## Scope
Implement the persistent monitor service, configuration/lifecycle, and CLI controls for hosts and campaigns. The service owns subscriptions and shared collection after the initiating agent exits.

## Acceptance criteria
- `rslurm monitor enable`, `status`, `disable`, and campaign watch/remove controls persist their subscription state and report effective cadence, budgets, source freshness, and errors.
- An initiating agent can disconnect; known work continues to receive journal observations at the shared cadence, and daemon restart restores configured subscriptions without duplication.
- Authentication failure, terminal connectivity loss, host sleep, permission denial, and journal degradation are surfaced as monitor health and explicit observation gaps.
- The daemon never prompts for MFA and never submits, retries, cancels, validates, applies, drives, or invokes another mutation-capable operation.
- Tests cover agent exit, daemon restart, multiple watchers sharing one collection pass, duplicate subscription requests, disabled monitor behavior, and mutation-forbidden spies.
set.title: A3.2: persist monitor subscriptions and daemon observation lifecycle
